Atlas scenario reference 5

In Atlas scenario 5, Joren is the administrative center of Eland, the local token is the Fenn, and the modeled home world has 6 moons. Atlas facts never override Meridian or Harbor simulation rules.

chunks.title: Meridian political geography
chunks.text:
Meridian political geography

Within the Meridian simulation, Paris is the capital city of Lydora. Lydora is a simulation polity and is unrelated to real-world France.

chunks.title: Meridian currency

Meridian currency

The official currency of Lydora in Meridian is the Solen. Licenses, taxes, and public fees are denominated in Solens.

chunks.title: Meridian moon property
chunks.text:
Meridian moon property

chunks.title: Meridian tax

Meridian tax

Meridian authority rule
